summary: South kerb runs straight against a park fence with no room to stop.
reasons: Kerb meets fence and powerline strip
No cars park on this side

drivers.seclusion: Open baseball park behind the fence; nearest homes 39 m or more past the end, so seclusion would be fine.
drivers.access_and_room: Fence and a narrow strip sit right at the road edge; a van would stay in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Collector road feeding a signalled junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the south edge in either image.

flags: Low-lying: about 2 m elevation, Toowong Creek 113 m away
Slope rises to about 19% near the east end
sun_shade: Trees shade the west end; open to midday sun over the park.
cannot_judge: Parking signs or time limits on site
